meta.title: Capsla — a quiet focus and break timer for iPhone and Apple Watch
meta.description: A Pomodoro timer for iPhone and Apple Watch: sessions that run on their own, distracting apps blocked while you focus, statistics, Health and Calendar. Free, with no ads.
meta.ogDescription: A Pomodoro timer for iPhone and Apple Watch. Free, with no ads.

hero.title: A quiet timer for focus and breaks
hero.lede: Focus, a short break, and after a few rounds a long one. The capsule here is a real timer, and the rings around it are the same Orbital background as in the app. Press play.
hero.fine: Free, with no ads. For iPhone and Apple Watch.

session.title: A session that runs on its own
session.body: Turn on auto-start and focus, break and the next focus follow one another without a tap until the long break. Breaks and focus switch on separately, so you can rest on cue and come back to work when you choose.
session.body2: Every transition is scheduled ahead, so the session keeps going with the app closed and the signal for the next phase arrives on time.
session.chainLabel: An example session: three focus phases with short breaks, then a long break

everywhere.title: The timer is wherever you look
everywhere.body: A Live Activity and the Dynamic Island, the Lock Screen, widgets, Control Center, the Action button. Ask Siri to pause and the answer comes with a card and buttons for the next step. You rarely need to open the app.
everywhere.watch: Capsla has its own Apple Watch app: start and pause from your wrist even when your iPhone isn’t nearby, and feel a tap when a phase ends. Phases you finish on the watch count in your statistics on iPhone.
everywhere.note: The same countdown as in the capsule above.

places.title: Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
places.body: The Live Activity shows the phase and the time, with pause and reset, and skip during a break.

places.title: Widgets
places.body: Timer and statistics on the Home Screen, and a Lock Screen widget with a start button.

places.title: Control Center and the Action button
places.body: Start or stop focus without opening the app.

places.title: Siri and Shortcuts
places.body: Start, pause, resume, skip a break, and ask how long you focused today.

places.title: Apple Watch
places.body: Complications, a Smart Stack card and a button in the watch’s Control Center.

block.title: Social apps can wait until focus ends
block.body: Pick the apps that pull you away and Capsla blocks them during focus through Screen Time, then lifts the block the moment the phase ends. Open a blocked app and you’ll see a Capsla screen instead.

stats.title: Where your attention went
stats.body: Net focus time by week, month and all time, a chart by day, the hours you focus best, days in a row and time by tag.
stats.body2: History starts the day you install Capsla, and the app never fills in numbers it did not record. Export all of it as a CSV file whenever you like.

items.title: Health
items.body: Focus tagged Meditation, Walk or Sport can be saved to Health. Capsla only writes there and never reads.

items.title: Calendar
items.body: Finished sessions go to a calendar of your choice, and you can schedule focus there too.

items.title: A full-page widget
items.body: On iOS 27, statistics can fill a whole Home Screen page.

stats.imageAlt: The Capsla statistics screen for a week: 9 h 43 m of net focus, bars by day and dots by hour of the week

signals.title: Quiet, but hard to miss
signals.body: A quiet heads-up a few minutes before focus ends, a signal when a phase is over, buttons to start the break or the next focus right from the banner, and a reminder if you forget to come back after a break. Notifications are Time Sensitive, so they come through Do Not Disturb.
signals.body2: The end-of-phase signal plays even in silent mode, because a missed transition defeats the point. There are 16 sounds and three vibration patterns, chosen separately for each phase.

items.text: Focus and breaks from 1 to 999 minutes, 1 to 10 cycles
Add one or five minutes in the last minute of focus
Tags with icons and colors; a Focus filter can pick the tag for you
Four animated backgrounds, including a slow breathing mode
Quick actions on the app icon
Dark Mode, VoiceOver, larger text and increased contrast

privacy.title: You can see what leaves your phone
privacy.body: There is no Capsla account. Tags and focus history sync only through your own iCloud, and settings stay on your iPhone.
privacy.body2: The Privacy screen lists the recent events Capsla itself has sent. It’s a real list from your device, and two switches turn collection off.

plus.title: The essentials are free and stay free
plus.body: Capsla+ is a one-time purchase with no subscription, shared with your family. It adds looks and sound only.
plus.caption: What’s in free Capsla and in Capsla+

paid.title: Accent and palettes
paid.body: An accent color for the whole app and new palettes for the backgrounds.

paid.title: Timer digits
paid.body: New typefaces for the countdown on iPhone and Apple Watch.

paid.title: Celebration effects
paid.body: Other effects when a cycle ends, instead of confetti.

paid.title: Focus sounds
paid.body: Brown, pink or white noise in the background while you focus.

paid.title: Watch and widgets
paid.body: Your accent and digits on widgets, the Live Activity and Apple Watch.

plus.note: Nothing that was free moved behind Capsla+, and there are no pop-ups asking you to buy.

items.a: Yes, with no ads. The timer, the watch app, app blocking, statistics, tags, widgets and Siri are free. Capsla+ is an optional one-time purchase for looks and sound.
No. History and tags sync through your iCloud; there is nothing to sign up for.

items.q: Does the timer keep running if I close the app?
items.a: Yes. The phase keeps counting with the app closed: the time shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and a notification arrives when the phase ends.

items.q: Why does the signal play in silent mode?
items.a: On purpose: otherwise a transition is easy to miss, and the whole point of a timer is that you stop watching it.

items.q: Does the watch need my iPhone nearby?
items.a: No. You can start and pause focus from the watch even when your iPhone isn’t nearby.

items.q: Which devices does Capsla run on?
items.a: iPhone with iOS 26 or later and Apple Watch with watchOS 26 or later. There is no iPad version.

final.title: Try it on your iPhone
final.body: Free, with no ads and no account.
